card.head: Investors are wary of AI debt, and firms that borrow to build for AI feel it first.
card.body: AI borrowing is reportedly slowing and insuring AI builder Oracle's debt sets a record. Watch chipmaker TSMC on 15 October: a flat outlook is a first warning.

clip.line: And for the bigger picture: Reports say A I borrowing is slowing, and chipmaker T S M C's Thursday results test chip demand. This is not financial advice.
